claim_being_audited: The Actor claims this release can be certified because current aggregate readiness is positive and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, provided the certification basis relies on current evidence and explicit disclosure of the telehealth discharge planning weakness rather than stale prior approval or informal monitoring.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material segment weakness is already disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
Use suspicious when the Actor's direction is plausible but a required support link is missing or unresolved.
Prior approval of the same model family is contextual only and cannot substitute for current-release evidence after the retrieval change and new eval batch.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents support launch readiness context but do not by themselves satisfy the model-card certification policy.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or equivalent release documentation showing the telehealth discharge planning weakness is explicitly disclosed.
Provide any approved risk acceptance, mitigation sign-off, or governance approval covering this subgroup regression before launch.
Provide the current-release documentation section that incorporates the current evaluation batch results, including the telehealth slice outcome.
specific_concerns: The policy threshold is not satisfied by aggregate readiness alone; current release documentation must reflect current evaluation results and the material segment weakness must be disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
The evidence shows a current telehealth discharge planning regression below the warning threshold, which is a material limitation for a named launch use case.
There is no admissible evidence that the current model card already includes the required disclosure language.
There is no admissible evidence of approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation for the telehealth subgroup weakness.
The Actor's certification rationale is conditional on future or assumed disclosure, but the packet does not prove that condition is currently met.
unsupported_claims: Certification is presently supportable on the available record.
The current model card reflects current evaluation results and explicitly discloses the telehealth subgroup weakness.
Informal monitoring can help operationally, but the record does not show it has been converted into reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or approved governance cover.
